parts:
not sure what you are trying to achieve. something like this??:
x1 <- c(0,12,24,48,72,96)
y1 <- c(0.001,0.01,0.1,1,5)
#plot
#p <- ggplot(pktest, aes(atime, conc,shape=droplevels(frate))) +
p <- ggplot(pktest, aes(atime, conc,shape=frate)) +

geom_hline(yintercept = seq(0,5,by=1), col="white", size=0.2,
       alpha=0.1)+

geom_line() + geom_point(size=2.5) +
       facet_wrap(~ nsubj,ncol=3)+

scale_x_continuous(breaks=x1,labels=x1) +
       scale_shape_manual("Flow-rate (mL/min)",values = c(1,16))+
       opts(title = "Subjects log Concentrations. X mg/kg.",
            legend.position =c(0.54, 0.8),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), axis.text.y =
            theme_text(size = 10))
print(p)
